description: This header file defines casting templates such as implicit_cast and bit_cast used for type conversions in the Abseil C++ library. It includes implementation details, licensing information, and conditional support for C++20 features.

methods.name: implicit_cast
methods.description: Performs an implicit conversion between types following C++ language rules, allowing safe implicit conversions and aiding in explicit code annotation.

methods.name: bit_cast
methods.description: Creates a new value of type Dest with the same bitwise representation as the source value of type Source, used for low-level type punning while avoiding undefined behavior.
